set.pl: Patrick Mulchrone's farm, sec. 2 T11N R5W, town of Franklin, about 3 mi W of Liberty Pole; the 1896 Vernon County plat shows his 113-acre farm with a building dot, with the Zitzner (Fitzner) 160 adjoining in the same section
pinev: 1896 Vernon County plat book (WHS W0170V6): Mulchrone 113.02 acres with a building dot in sec. 2 T11N R5W, placed from the BLM PLSS grid
Matches the Censor of 6 Sep 1899 (close to Zitzner's, 3 mi W of Liberty Pole); one of the finders' families and his brother adjoin on the plat

tw-mulchrone-liberty-pole-1899.st: Placed (2026) on the 1896 Vernon County plat: his farm was in sec. 2 T11N R5W, next to the Zitzner land, so the LiDAR hollow 4.5 km NW noted earlier is probably not his house. 1 m LiDAR (2020) at the new spot shows an old lane running in from the north-south road on the east to a small levelled pad by the pin; no obvious cellar hollow, so the dug-out foundation may have been filled or plowed.
src: Vernon County plat book (1896), town of Franklin (Wisconsin Historical Society W0170V6)
